title: LORD, HELP ME REDEEM LOST TIME
text: I greet you this morning in the matchless name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Glory be to God. I want you to understand that you have not stumbled upon this message by accident. The very fact that you are listening to this word right now is a prophetic orchestration of the Holy Spirit. God has seen the cry of your heart. He has heard your groaning in the midnight hour and he has positioned you to receive a fresh impartation that will terminate every cycle of stagnation in your life. Can I tell you something? The enemy fights you the most when your time of visitation is near. When heaven is about to release what has been locked up in the archives of divine purpose, the adversary intensifies his operations. But I prophesy to somebody this morning, every weapon fashioned against your advancement shall be rendered powerless by the blood of Jesus. You are stepping into a season where lost years will be recovered, where delayed blessings will manifest with unusual speed, where the enemy will be forced to vomit everything he has stolen from your life. Now, the spirit of the Lord led me to minister to you on this subject because I have discerned in the realm of the spirit that many of you are carrying a burden. You look at your life and you see wasted opportunities. You see years that have gone by without significant progress. You remember doors that were opened that you failed to enter. You remember seasons when God spoke and you delayed in obedience. You remember moments when divine connections were available but you were distracted. And now there is a consciousness, there is an awareness that time has been lost. But I have come as a prophet of the most high God to declare to you that the God we serve is the God of restoration. He is the God who makes all things beautiful in his time. He is the God who gives back what the cankerworm and the palmer have eaten. Listen to me very carefully. The fact that time has passed does not mean purpose has expired. The fact that you delay does not mean you are disqualified. The fact that you fail does not mean you are finished. God specializes in redeeming lost time. Let me take you to the scriptures because I don't want to minister to you from human wisdom. In Joel 2:2, the Bible says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmer, my great army, which I sent among you." Somebody shout, "Hallelujah." This is the covenant promise of God. This is not motivational speaking. This is the prophetic word of the Lord. God said, "I will restore." He didn't say maybe. He didn't say possibly. He said, "I will restore the years." Now, I want you to understand something profound. When God restores, he doesn't just give you back what you lost. He gives you back with multiplication. When the enemy steals from you, he takes away. But when God restores, he gives you double for your trouble. He gives you beauty for ashes. He gives you the oil of joy for mourning. He turns your mourning into dancing. This is the nature of divine restoration. It is not just recovery. It is recovery with interest. There is somebody listening to me right now and for years you have been battling with the consciousness of wasted time. You are in your 30s and you feel like your 20s were wasted. You are in your 40s and you feel like a whole decade passed without productivity. You are in your 50s and you are wondering if it is too late for greatness. Let me speak to you prophetically. God is about to accelerate your progress in such a way that what should have taken 20 years will happen in 2 years. What should have taken a decade will happen in 12 months. You are entering a season of supernatural acceleration. Can I share something with you from the life of Jacob? This man worked 7 years for Rachel and at the end of the seven years Laban deceived him and gave him Leah. Can you imagine the pain? Can you imagine the disappointment? Seven years of labor, seven years of waiting, seven years of anticipation, and at the end of it all, you get the wrong thing. That is the epitome of wasted time. But I want you to see what happened. The Bible says Jacob worked another 7 years, 14 years. But when God began to bless him, when God began to prosper him, the Bible says in Genesis chapter 31 that his wealth multiplied so rapidly that Laban and his sons became envious. What am I saying? God gave him back those years. God compensated him for every moment of disappointment. And I prophesy to you this morning, every year the enemy stole from you, God will pay you back with compound interest. Every opportunity you missed, God will create a greater one. Every door that closed in your face, God will open a door that no man can shut. This is your season of recovery. Now let me tell you why many people do not experience the redemption of lost time. It is because they are living in regret instead of living in faith. They spend their days mourning over yesterday instead of contending for tomorrow. Listen to me. Regret is a trap of the enemy. Yes, you made mistakes. Yes, you wasted time. Yes, you were disobedient in certain seasons. But if you stay in the prison of regret, you will waste even more time. The Bible says in Philippians 3:13, "Forgetting those things which are behind and reaching forth onto those things which are before," Paul is teaching us a spiritual principle. You cannot move forward while looking backward. You cannot run your race while carrying the weight of past failures. There must come a moment when you make a quality decision to release the past and embrace the future. God is not asking you to pretend that you didn't waste time. He's asking you to believe that he can redeem it. There is a difference between denial and faith. Denial says, "I didn't waste time." Faith says, "I wasted time, but my God is able to restore it." Let me show you another dimension. In Ecclesiastes 3:1, the Bible says, "He hath made everything beautiful in his time." Did you see that? In his time, not in your time. What does this mean? It means that even though you delayed, even though you missed certain seasons, God has the ability to reorder events and bring beauty out of your chaos, God has the ability to take your mess and turn it into a message. God has the ability to take your test and turn it into a testimony. I remember ministering to a young man who came to me in tears. He said, "Pastor, I wasted my entire youth. I spent my 20s in sin, in disobedience, in rebellion. Now I am in my 30s and I feel like I'm starting from scratch. How can I recover all those years? And the spirit of the Lord gave me a word for him. I said, "Son, God is going to use your story of redemption to reach people that a man with a perfect record could never reach. Your wasted years will become your greatest weapon in ministry. And I am here to tell you this morning, your pain is not pointless. Your delay is not destruction. God is about to turn your testimony into a tool for his glory. People who meet you 5 years from now will not believe that you are the same person. They will look at your life and say, "If God can do this for him, he can do it for me." You are about to become a working advertisement of the redemptive power of God. Now, there are practical steps to redeeming lost time. I want to give you spiritual keys that will activate recovery in your life. The first key is repentance. You must identify where you went wrong. You must acknowledge before God the areas where you were disobedient, where you were distracted, where you were unfaithful. Repentance is not just feeling sorry. It is a change of direction. It is saying, "God, I was going this way, but from today I am turning to go your way." The second key is restitution where necessary. If your wasted time was as a result of stealing, lying or defrauding people, you need to make it right. Zakius understood this principle when he encountered Jesus. He didn't just say sorry. He said Lord I will restore four-fold what I have taken. And Jesus said today salvation has come to this house. There are blessings that cannot be released until you make restitution. There are doors that cannot open until you settle your debt spiritual and physical. The third key is realignment with divine purpose. You need to ask God what was your original plan for my life? What was your agenda before I got distracted? And when God shows you, you need to aggressively pursue it, you need to give yourself to it with intensity. You need to redeem the time because the days are evil. Every moment counts now. Every day matters. Every hour is significant. You don't have the luxury of procrastination anymore. You are in a season where you must be violent about your purpose. Can I tell you what the Bible says in Ephesians 5:16? It says redeeming the time because the days are evil. The word redeeming there means to buy back. It means to purchase from the enemy. It means to recover from the slave market. What is Paul saying? He's saying that time is a commodity. It can be stolen. It can be wasted. But it can also be redeemed. You can buy it back through intentional living, through focused pursuit of God's purpose, through militant prayers, through aggressive fasting. I sense in my spirit that there are people listening to me right now. And God is about to vindicate you before your mockers. People who laughed at you, people who said you will never amount to anything, people who wrote you off as a failure. God is about to prove them wrong. In one year, you will become the topic of discussion. In one season, your story will change so dramatically that your enemies will be confused. This is what God does when he redeems lost time. He does it in such a spectacular way that it becomes a testimony. Look at Joseph. 13 years in slavery and prison, 13 years of wasted potential, delayed destiny, locked up greatness. But when God's time came, in one day, Joseph went from the prison to the palace. In one day, the slave became a prime minister. In one day, the forgotten became the celebrated. And I prophesy to you, you are about to experience a one-day miracle. You are about to experience a suddenly of the Lord. What has taken years to manifest is about to happen in a moment. Now, let me tell you something very important. When God begins to restore your lost time, the enemy will fight you. He will bring discouragement. He will bring distractions. He will bring accusations. He will remind you of your past. He will tell you that you are not qualified. He will tell you that it is too late. But I want you to understand that the devil is a liar. He is the father of lies. And his job is to make you abort your miracle before it fully manifests. This is why you need to be violent IN THE SPIRIT. THIS IS WHY you need to pray with intensity. This is why you need to decree and declare the word of God over your life. The Bible says the kingdom of heaven suffers violence and the violent take it by force. You cannot be passive in this season. You cannot be lukewarm in this hour. You must contend. You must wrestle. You must war in the spirit. Let me tell you what I do when the enemy tries to remind me of wasted time. I remind him of Calvary. I remind him that the blood of Jesus has canceled every charge against me. I remind him that I am not what I used to be. I remind him that old things have passed away and all things have become new. I remind him that I am a new creation in Christ Jesus. And when I remind him of these truths, he flees because he cannot stand against the authority of the redeemed. I want you to lift up your hands right now, wherever you are. I don't care if you are in traffic. I don't care if you are in your bedroom. I don't care if you are in your office. Lift up your hands as a sign of surrender to God. And I want you to say this after me. Lord, I repent of every moment I wasted. I repent of every opportunity I squandered. I repent of every season I spent outside your will. But today I receive your mercy. Today I receive your grace. Today I activate the covenant of restoration. You said in your word that you will restore the years. I hold you to your word. I hold you to your promise. Let your redemptive power be released in my life right now in the name of Jesus. Somebody needs to share this prayer with someone who is struggling with the consciousness of wasted time. There is somebody in your contact list. There is somebody in your family. There is somebody in your circle who needs to hear this word. Don't keep this to yourself. Be a blessing to someone else. Forward this message. Share this prayer. Let it go viral in the realm of the spirit because when God's word goes forth, it accomplishes what he sent it to do. Now, I want to pray for you. But before I pray, I need you to understand that prayer is not just words. Prayer is a legal transaction in the spirit. When we pray according to the word of God, we are activating covenant promises. We are releasing angelic ministry. We are binding the powers of darkness. We are opening portals of heaven. So don't just listen to this prayer passively. engage with it, agree with it, let your spirit connect with the anointing that is being released. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace on behalf of every person listening to this message. Lord, you know their pain. You know their struggles. You know the tears they have cried in secret because of wasted years and lost opportunities. But Father, your word says that you are the God of restoration. Your word says that you give beauty for ashes. Your word says that you restore the years that the locust has eaten. So right now in the authority of the name of Jesus, I speak to every spirit of delay. I speak to every spirit of stagnation. I speak to every spirit of backwardness. I command you to lose your hold over the lives of God's children. You have no legal right. You have no covenant authority. The blood of Jesus has canceled your assignment. Release them now in the name of Jesus. I decree and declare that this is a season of supernatural acceleration. What should have taken 10 years will happen in one year. What should have taken 5 years will happen in 6 months. I speak unusual speed. I speak divine acceleration. I speak uncommon favor. I speak open doors that no man can shut. Lord, let your people experience the manifestation of Isaiah 60:22. A little one shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time. Father, I pray for every wasted investment. I pray for every aborted project. I pray for every abandoned dream. I pray for every lost opportunity, let there be recovery. Let there be restoration. Let there be multiplication. Where the enemy stole one, let them recover 10. Where the enemy destroyed one thing, let them build 10 things. This is the season of double portion. T his is the season of abundant recompense. I speak to wombs that have been barren for years. I speak to businesses that have been stagnant for years. I speak to ministries that have been struggling for years. I speak to careers that have been stuck for years. I declare acceleration. I declare breakthrough. I declare uncommon manifestations. The time of your favor has come. This is your appointed time. This is your set time. And I prophesy to someone within the next 90 days you will see the hand of God move in your situation in a way that will leave you speechless. Within the next 3 months there will be a testimony. There will be a turnaround. There will be a miracle. This is not motivation. This is prophecy. This is not empty words. This is the word of the Lord. Write it down. Date it. And when it happens, give God all the glory. Father, I pray that you will baptize your people with the spirit of wisdom and understanding. Let them know how to navigate this season. Let them know when to move and when to wait. Let them know when to speak and when to be silent. Let them know when to fight and when to rest. Give them divine strategies that will accelerate their progress. Open their eyes to see opportunities that others cannot see. Give them access to places where ordinary men cannot enter. I curse every cause that has been working against their progress. I break every evil covenant that has been keeping them in cycles of failure. I render powerless every witchcraft manipulation, every satanic embgo, every demonic blockade, every ancestral limitation. By the blood of Jesus, I set them free. By the power of the Holy Spirit, I deliver them. by the authority of the word of God. I liberate them. And I declare that from this day forward, everything they touch shall prosper. Every project they start shall succeed. Every seed they sow shall yield harvest. Every investment they make shall bring returns. Every relationship they build shall be fruitful. Every door they approach shall open. This is their season of uncommon favor. This is their season of unusual grace. This is their season of supernatural turnaround. Father, I pray that you will raise up divine helpers for them. Let them encounter people who will accelerate their destiny. Let them meet mentors who will pour wisdom into their lives. Let them connect with partners who will finance their vision. Let them align with friends who will strengthen them in their journey. Remove every destiny killer from their path. Separate them from every destiny hijacker. Disconnect them from every destiny destroyer. I speak healing to every emotional wound caused by wasted time. I speak restoration to every broken heart. I speak peace to every troubled mind. Let the joy of the Lord become their strength. Let the peace of God that passes all understanding guard their hearts and minds in Christ Jesus. Let hope rise again. Let faith be rekindled. Let love be restored. And finally, Father, I pray that when you restore their lost time, when you redeem their wasted years, when you accelerate their progress, they will give you all the glory. They will not become proud. They will not become arrogant. They will not forget your mercies, but they will become walking testimonies of your goodness. They will become living epistles of your grace. They will become monuments of your faithfulness. Let their lives provoke others to seek you. Let their testimonies inspire others to trust you. Let their stories encourage others to believe you. Use them, Lord. Anoint them, commission them, and let them fulfill their purpose before they leave this earth. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I have prayed. And every child of God who believes says, "Amen." Now, I want you to do something very important for the next 21 days. I want you to pray this prayer every morning. I want you to speak these declarations over your life. I want you to meditate on the scriptures we have shared. This is not a one-time event. This is a spiritual discipline. You are reprogramming your mind. You are aligning your spirit with heaven's agenda for your life. And let me tell you what will happen. As you pray, as you declare, as you meditate, you will begin to sense a shift in the atmosphere. You will begin to see opportunities that were hidden. You will begin to meet people that will connect you to your destiny. You will begin to receive ideas that will revolutionize your life. This is how redemption of lost time works. It is both sudden and progressive. There will be sudden breakthroughs, but there will also be progressive transformation. Can I leave you with one final word? Stop comparing your journey with someone else's journey. Stop looking at people who are younger than you and are ahead of you and allowing that to discourage you. God has a custommade plan for your life. Your path is unique. Your timing is unique. Your assignment is unique. What matters is not how fast you are going compared to others. What matters is whether you are moving in the direction of God's purpose for your life. David was anointed king at 17. But he became king at 30. 13 years between the promise and the manifestation. But those 13 years were not wasted. God was preparing him. God was refining him. God was developing his character. And when he finally sat on the throne, he was ready. He was mature. He was equipped. So stop despising your season of preparation. Stop resenting your season of delay. God is working all things together for your good. I sense in the spirit that somebody needs to hear this additional word because God is not done speaking to you. The Holy Spirit is impressing upon my heart that there is a deeper dimension to this message that must be released. You see when we talk about redeeming lost time we must understand that there are different categories of lost time and each one requires a specific spiritual approach. There is time lost to ignorance. This is when you wasted years simply because you didn't know better. You were not exposed to truth. You were not taught the ways of God. You grew up in an environment where nobody showed you the path of righteousness. And for years you walked in darkness not because you were rebellious but because you were blind. But I want to tell you what Jesus said in John chapter 9:39. For judgment I am come into this world that they which see not might see. God specializes in opening blind eyes. He specializes in bringing revelation to those who have been in ignorance. And let me tell you something powerful. When God delivers you from ignorance, he doesn't punish you for the years you spent in darkness. No, he begins to download wisdom into your spirit at an accelerated rate. He begins to teach you mysteries that other people spent decades learning. I have seen people who came to Christ in their 40s and within 5 years they had the spiritual depth of people who had been in the faith for 30 years. Why? Because God accelerated their spiritual growth. He compensated them for the time they lost in ignorance. Then there is time lost to disobedience. This is different from ignorance. This is when you knew what God wanted you to do, but you chose to go your own way. Like Jonah, who was told to go to Nineveh, but went to Tashish instead. And let me tell you what happens when you waste time through disobedience. You end up in a belly of a fish. You end up in a place of confinement, limitation, and darkness. But here is the beauty of God's mercy. Even in the belly of the fish, when Jonah prayed, when Jonah repented, God commanded the fish to vomit him out. And the Bible says the word of the Lord came to him the second time. Do you hear what I'm saying? God gives second chances. God restores backsliders. God reinstates the disobedient. Yes, you will lose some time. Yes, there will be consequences. But God will still use you. God will still fulfill his purpose through you. Some of you have been in the belly of disobedience for years. But I prophesy to you this morning, the fish is about to vomit you out. You are coming out of that dark place. You are coming out of that place of confinement. And when you come out, you will go straight to your assignment with a testimony that will shake nations. There is also time lost to battles. This is when you spend years fighting wars that God never assigned to you. You were fighting with family members. You were fighting with colleagues. You were fighting with church members. You were entangled in conflicts, drama, and confusion. And while you were busy fighting, your destiny was on hold. Your purpose was delayed. Your progress was stagnant. But the Bible says in 2 Timothy 2:4, "No man that worth entangled himself with the affairs of this life, that he may please him who had chosen him to be a soldier." Listen to me very carefully. There are battles that are beneath you. There are fights that are not worth your time. There are arguments that are designed by the enemy to distract you from your assignment. And one of the ways the devil wastes your time is by getting you involved in unnecessary conflicts. He makes you major on minor things. He makes you invest energy in temporal issues while eternal matters are neglected. But I decree over your life today, you are coming out of every satanic entanglement. You are disconnecting from every timewasting battle. You are focusing on what matters. You are prioritizing your divine assignment. And here is what God will do when you make that decision. He will fight your battles for you. You don't have to defend yourself anymore. You don't have to prove yourself anymore. You don't have to struggle anymore. The Bible says in Exodus 14:14, "The Lord shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace." When you learn to hold your peace, when you learn to rest in God, when you learn to let him vindicate you, you will be shocked at how much time you redeem, you will be amazed at how much you can accomplish when you are not wasting energy on battles. Now, there is another category I must mention. Time lost to fear. This is perhaps the most subtle thief of time. Fear makes you hesitate when you should move. Fear makes you silent when you should speak. Fear makes you hide when you should shine. How many of you know that fear has paralyzed more destinies than any other force? People who had potential but were too afraid to step out. People who had gifts but were too afraid to use them. People who had ideas but were too afraid to implement them. But let me tell you what 2 Timothy 1:7 says, "For God have not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." If God didn't give you fear, where did it come from? the enemy. It is a satanic plantation in your mind designed to keep you from fulfilling your destiny. And today, by the authority vested in me as a minister of the gospel, I uproot every spirit of fear from your life. I cast out every tormenting spirit. I break every stronghold of timidity. And I release upon you the spirit of boldness, the spirit of courage, the spirit of faith. From today, you will not be afraid to start that business. You will not be afraid to write that book. You will not be afraid to start that ministry. You will not be afraid to go back to school. You will not be afraid to relocate. You will not be afraid to step into your greatness. The Lord is with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. And when God is for you, who can be against you? I also want to address time lost to wrong relationships. How many years have people wasted in relationships that were never ordained by God? Friendships that drained them instead of building them, partnerships that limited them instead of expanding them. Romantic relationships that delayed them instead of accelerating them. And the sad thing is that many people know the relationship is wrong, but they stay because they afraid of starting over. They afraid of being alone. They afraid of what people will say. But let me tell you something that will set you free. It is better to be alone and in God's will than to be in a relationship and out of God's will. It is better to walk your path lonely and arrive at your destiny than to have company on a journey that leads to destruction. The Bible says in Amos 3:3, "Can two walk together except they be agreed?" When there is no agreement, when there is no alignment, when there is no shared vision, you are wasting your time. And I prophesy to somebody, God is about to disconnect you from every destiny killer. He's about to separate you from every every vision drainer. Yes, it will hurt. Yes, it will be painful. Yes, you will feel the loss. But 6 months from now, you will look back and thank God for the separation. You will realize that what you thought was a loss was actually a gain. You will understand that God was protecting you from a greater disaster. Let me share one more thing before we go deeper into prayer. There is time lost to comfort zones. This is when you settle for less than God's best because stepping into the fullness of your calling requires risk, sacrifice, and discomfort. You have a job that pays your bills, but God is calling you to entrepreneurship. You have a comfortable church, but God is calling you to plant a church. You have a stable life, but God is calling you to the mission field. And because stepping out is uncomfortable, because it requires faith, because it demands total dependence on God, you stay where you are. And years go by and potential remains untapped and gifts remain unused and purpose remains unfulfilled. But the Bible says in Hebrews 11:8, "By faith Abraham when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed and he went out, not knowing whether he went." Abraham left his comfort zone. He left the familia. He left his father's house. And because he obeyed, he became the father of many nations. He became the friend of God. He became a blessing to all the families of the earth. What am I saying to you? Your miracle is outside your comfort zone. Your breakthrough is on the other side of your fear. Your destiny is beyond your current location. And until you are willing to take the step of faith, until you are willing to embrace the uncertainty, until you are willing to trust God completely, you will remain in the wilderness of mediocrity. But I sense that someone is ready. Someone is done with settling. Someone is ready to step out. And I decree over your life as you step out in faith, God will meet you. As you take the first step, he will make a way. As you move forward, doors will open. This is your season of uncommon courage. Now, lift your hands again because I want to pray a specific prayer for the redemption of lost time. And as I pray, I want you to see yourself 10 years from now. I want you to see yourself living in the fullness of God's purpose. I want you to see yourself walking in divine health, in supernatural abundance, in uncommon favor, in marital bliss, in ministerial fruitfulness. See it, visualize it because what you can see in the spirit, you can possess in the natural. Father, I thank you for every person who has stayed with this word. I thank you because their persistence in listening is evidence of their hunger for transformation. And you said in your word that those who hunger and thirst after righteousness shall be filled. So right now, fill them, Lord. Fill them with your spirit. Fill them with your wisdom. Fill them with your power. Fill them with your grace. I pray specifically for those who lost time to ignorance. Let this be their season of accelerated learning. Let revelation knowledge flood their hearts. Let them understand mysteries that have been hidden. Let them receive downloads from heaven that will catapult them into their destiny. Let them become so wise, so insightful, so discerning that people will wonder where they acquired such depth. I pray for those who lost time to disobedience. Father, I thank you for your mercy that endures forever. I thank you that your compassions fail not. They are new every morning. So release your mercy upon them now. Wash them, cleanse them, restore them, and give them the grace to obey you completely from this day forward. Let their latter obedience erase their former disobedience. Let their future faithfulness overshadow their past failures. I prophesy acceleration. I prophesy multiplication. I prophesy manifestation. What was delayed is now being released. What was blocked is now being opened. What was stolen is now being restored. This is the season. This is the time. This is the moment in Jesus mighty name. Amen. And amen. I declare over your life this morning, your latter shall be greater than your former. Your end shall be better than your beginning. You shall finish strong. You shall end well. You shall die empty, having fulfilled every assignment God gave you. This is the prophetic word of the Lord over your life. Receive it, believe it, walk in it. And may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit rest upon you now and forever in Jesus mighty name. Amen.
